description: Yesterday's beat escalated a vmscan credential failure (Qualys VM API 403). Today's credential report shows it ok. The beat should see the problem is gone and not raise it again.
memory: Escalated: cti-vmscan --check failed, Qualys VM API 403 Forbidden. Alert sent to the operator.
vmscan 403 still open, already escalated; not re-raised.

must.why: the problem it escalated has cleared; there is nothing new to tell the operator
the daily credential report is how it learns the 403 has cleared

should.why: it says the earlier problem is resolved
